mapper.select: SELECT A.ASSET_CODE AS assetId, A.ASSET_NAME AS assetName, A.VDATE AS vDate, A.MDATE AS mDate, A.ORG_ASSET_TYPE1 AS orgAssetType1, A.CHB_ISSUER_ID AS chbIssuerId, A.CHB_FINANCIER_ID AS chbFinancierId, A.ASSET_TYPE2 AS informationAssetsId, A.CHB_MANAGER_ID AS chbManagerId, A.ASSET_TYPE2 AS assetType2, B.TDY_COST_AMT AS holdQtyAmount, B.TDY_COST_AMT AS holdAmount, A.CCY AS ccy, 0 AS onPassageAmt, '1018' AS orgId, '91110000100011743X' AS bankMark, STR_TO_DATE(#{batchDateEnd,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%Y-%m-%d') AS dateStatus, A.DATA_SOURCE AS groupId FROM CHB_ASSET_INFO A LEFT JOIN ( SELECT basis.ASSET_ID, SUM(basis.POS_AMT), SUM(basis.TDY_COST_AMT) AS TDY_COST_AMT FROM ( SELECT temp.ASSET_ID AS ASSET_ID, temp.POS_AMT AS POS_AMT , temp.TDY_COST_AMT AS TDY_COST_AMT FROM ( SELECT PROD_ID, ASSET_ID, POS_AMT, TDY_COST_AMT, ROW_NUMBER() over( partition BY PROD_ID,ASSET_ID ORDER BY VALUE_DATE DESC ) monthMarkNo FROM CHB_ASSETS_BASIS_DATA WHERE STATUS !='D') temp WHERE temp.monthMarkNo=1) basis GROUP BY basis.ASSET_ID) B ON A.ASSET_CODE=B.ASSET_ID WHERE A.STATUS != 'D'
SELECT distinct ASSET_CODE AS assetCode, TRADE_COUNTER As tradeCounter FROM CHB_INVEST_TRADE
SELECT CUSTOMER_ID AS customerId, INDUSTRY2 AS industry2 FROM MST_CUSTOMER_INFO_ADD
